name: Raven Industries (CNH) landing page: automated and autonomous farm tech
title: Raven Industries (CNH) landing page: automated and autonomous farm tech
answer: This is the homepage of Raven Industries, a brand of CNH, harvested on 26 September 2026. It is a marketing landing page rather than a technical or product document, so it offers positioning rather than detail. Its most useful statement is that Raven, under CNH ownership, describes itself as supplying automated and autonomous farm technologies and precision agriculture solutions intended to improve productivity, sustainability and profitability, and to help farms maximise yield using fewer resources. No products, models, customers or performance figures appear on the page.

sections.body: Raven Industries publishes this page, describing itself as a brand of CNH. It is a corporate homepage rather than a report, case study or specification sheet, and it carries no publication date beyond the harvest date of 26 September 2026. Its scope is limited to a short statement of what Raven says it does: automated and autonomous farm technologies and precision agriculture solutions. There is no product list, no technical explanation and no named customer or trial.
sections.heading: What this source is

sections.body: The page makes a few claims and little else. First, Raven, a brand of CNH, provides automated and autonomous farm technologies, and says these help farmers serve the world. Second, its precision agriculture solutions are designed to improve productivity, sustainability and profitability. Third, it says it is advancing farming through technology and innovation, and that it helps farming operations maximise yield with fewer resources, described as sustaining a growing world. The wording repeats across the page, which is typical of a landing page built for search and navigation rather than explanation. Nothing here describes how any of this works, which machines carry it, or what results it has produced.
sections.heading: What it says

sections.body: The text gives no numbers, dates, product names or performance figures. The only claims are qualitative: automated and autonomous farm technologies, precision agriculture solutions, improved productivity, sustainability and profitability, and maximising yield with fewer resources. It also states the ownership position that Raven is a brand of CNH.
sections.heading: Figures and claims worth noting

sections.body: A reader tracking AI in agriculture would use this page only as a pointer to who owns which part of the equipment layer. It confirms that Raven sits under CNH and that CNH's autonomous and precision agriculture effort is presented under the Raven brand, which supports the claim that CNH and Raven work on fleets beyond Deere. It does not support any stronger claim about driverless tractors, path planning or precision application, because those terms do not appear in the text. Treat it as an ownership and positioning signal, then go to product or technical material for the substance.
sections.heading: What it means for AI in Agriculture

sections.body: The page is commercial and promotional, written to sell and to rank in search. It is undated, undetailed and partial: no products, no specifications, no deployments, no customers, no results and no explanation of the AI involved. It cannot be used to evidence technical capability, and any claim about driverless tractor technology or AI path planning would need a different source.
